notes: This collection stores canonical regulation text only, not source-channel wrapper notices.

The target collection is source-channel-agnostic: future canonical regulation sources may promote into the same collection.

Current display-title truth preserves the full edition label semantics such as 2026版 or 2026年修订; it does not collapse display_title to a bare year token.
Current execution preserves regulation_title_normalized and source_title_literal as source-facing title metadata.
